annotations.title: Tell me when a business is free

description: Ask Speedi to tell somebody the moment a particular business sets its light green. Use this when nobody is free now and the person wants one business in particular — it is the answer to "nobody is available", not a consolation. You need the provider's id from find_available_providers and an email address to reach them on. ASK the person for their email in their own words; never invent one, never reuse one from earlier in the conversation unless they just gave it for this. They are emailed the moment that business goes green, including cancellations, and every email carries a one-click way to stop.

email.description: Where to tell them. Ask the person; do not guess or construct it.

providerId.description: The provider's id, exactly as find_available_providers returned it.

name: notify_me_when_free
